text:
Hi, I’m Noor Halden, a Python and NLP freelancer with 6 years of experience building practical AI assistants.

For a Q&A chatbot over your internal technical data, I can help create a reliable solution using Python and GPT-3 or an equivalent stack, tailored to your organization’s knowledge base and workflow.

I recently built a contract clause search assistant that answered questions over 9,000 contracts and quoted the exact clause and page used; it improved clause lookup from 25 minutes to 3 minutes. I also built a delivery support chatbot for Parcelwise Logistics that handled WhatsApp and SMS conversations, with 43% of conversations resolved without an agent.

I’d be glad to build a clear, accurate internal Q&A bot for your technical questions and answers.
